nodes.label: Architecture Decision
nodes.rationale: Implemented as two independently deployable Next.js TypeScript tiers because the HLD maps frontend and backend to separate ECS services; a single monolith was rejected. Exact unversioned LLD API paths were retained rather than introducing a generic /api/v1 prefix.

nodes.label: Session Storage Persistence
nodes.rationale: SessionProvider persists and rehydrates token/user through sessionStorage so protected confirmation retrieval survives client navigation and reload without placing JWTs in URLs.
